summary: result_projection._browser_safe_task_result: completed results are refused (never sliced) above 4096 scalars or on surrogate code points, with a content-free [task-result-display] marker emitted in finally; non-completed reasons use the 1024-scalar bound with a visible '...' and _bounded_result never exceeds 1024. Matches result_limits.py and client/projection.py validators. Verified by reading only; the runtime could not be imported here.

Non-completed failure reasons are not checked for lone surrogates in result_projection or bridge._validate_completion_text, but api.py:137 rejects surrogates at producer ingress and codex_app_server.send wraps serialization errors, so no reachable wrong outcome was demonstrated. Not reported as a finding (unverified, speculative).

_qualification.py checkpoint channel (nonce, ordinal, canonical-frame, duplicate-key, trailing-byte, oversize checks; fail-closed _fail/close) and capacity probe (non-blocking record lock marks observations incomplete and observations() raises; 256-record cap fails closed) are sound on read. The Windows-only _winapi pipe paths were not executed on Linux.

memory.BuiltinMemorySnapshot enforces exact str/bool types and a 4096 UTF-8 byte bound by equality-style check; a lone surrogate raises UnicodeEncodeError (a ValueError subclass), so it still fails closed. tests/test_memory.py exercises both boundary sides.

Limits: tests/conversation/test_streaming.py (5319 lines), test_streaming_cleanup_recovery.py, tests/support/qualification.py and test_recent_task_results.py were only sampled or grepped, not audited line by line; no mutation proofs were run. uv sync failed offline and aiohttp is absent, so no tests ran and no repro was executed. No finding survived verification.
